title: 2024 Topps Series 2 Fernando Tatis Jr. City to City Cycle-10 San Diego Padres
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Topps Series 2 Fernando Tatis Jr. trading card is a must-have for any San Diego Padres fan. The card features a stunning Rainbow Foil design and the city-to-city cycle logo, making it a unique addition to any collection. 

With its standard size and Topps manufacturer, this card is sure to impress. It is an insert card in the 2024 Topps set and features the player's name, team, and card number (CTC-10). Perfect for collectors and enthusiasts alike, this baseball trading card is a great investment for anyone looking to add to their collection.
